annotations.title: Explain how to fix an accessibility rule

description: Use this when the user asks what an axe-core accessibility rule means or how to fix it — typically a ruleId returned by scan_accessibility, such as color-contrast, image-alt, label or link-name. Returns plain-English steps and a code example. Do not use it to scan a site; use scan_accessibility for that.
name: explain_accessibility_issue
